mapper.sql: id, user_id, elderly_name, content, hit_keywords, risk_level, detect_type, ai_tip, matched_cases, is_handled, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fraud_alert (user_id, elderly_name, content, hit_keywords, risk_level, detect_type, ai_tip, matched_cases, is_handled, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{elderlyName}, #{content}, #{hitKeywords}, #{riskLevel}, #{detectType}, #{aiTip}, #{matchedCases}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fraud_alert WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fraud_alert WHERE create_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
SELECT FROM fraud_alert WHERE is_handled = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
